newsitem.title: ITALY: U.N. agency to airlift food to eastern Zaire.
newsitem.headline: U.N. agency to airlift food to eastern Zaire.

text.p: The U.N. World Food Programme said on Friday it would airlift food to eastern Zaire this weekend to support relief operations in the strife-torn region.

A WFP-chartered C-130 transport plane is due to arrive at Entebbe in Uganda on Saturday and would then take supplies to Bukavu and Goma in eastern Zaire, the United Nations' food aid agency said in a statement
"The limited airlift has been prompted because supply routes from the north and south to refugee camps in Goma and Bukavu remain closed due to mounting fighting in the area," it said.
The WFP said it was also discussing with other agencies the possibility of transporting relief items such as fuel and medicine.

More than 200,000 Rwandan and Burundian refugees have fled from camps north of the Zairean town of Uvira towards the city of Bukavu in the past week because of fighting between ethnic Tutsis and Zairean troops.
Aid officials fear the conflict could spread and the Tutsi-dominated armies in Burundi and Rwanda might intervene.
The WFP said 75 of its lorries loaded with 2,000 tonnes of food were blocked at the Zairean border. It was continuing talks with the Zairean government on allowing in aid by land.

Security conditions were worsening and tensions were rising at Bukavu amid fears of an impending rebel attack, it said. It had six days of supplies left and had reduced food rations to individuals by half to extend supplies to as many people as possible.
